title: ReactorUnpack recovered constants
description: `reactorunpack/NAME.config.json`: the values a protector kept out of the metadata, recovered by running the module's own decrypters. Written only where a run found some, so its absence from the run manifest means the sample kept none there. Strings that could be put back are also literals in the cleaned assembly; the rest exist only here.

Protector.description: Which protector kept these, by the tool's name for it.

Constants.description: One entry per distinct value, ordered by the decrypter that held it and then by its number.

constant.title: One value recovered from a protector's own decrypter

Kind.description: Which of the two fields below carries the value.

Decrypter.description: The metadata token of the method that was asked, so that two values held by different decrypters are not confused for one.

Id.description: The number the call site handed the decrypter, which is what makes this value that value.

Length.description: Characters for a string, bytes for an array.

Text.description: The string, where this is one. Null otherwise.

Base64.description: The bytes, where this is an array. Null otherwise. Base64 rather than hex because these run to hundreds of bytes and some are whole records.

Sites.description: Where the program asked for it, as a method token and an IL offset. A value asked for in several places is one entry naming all of them.
